description: This file implements core functionalities for managing object databases in a Git-like version control system, including object retrieval, caching, alternates handling, and transaction management.

classes.name: cached_object_entry
classes.description: Structure representing a cached object with its ID and value.

methods.name: find_cached_object
methods.description: Finds a cached object in the object store by object ID.

methods.name: odb_mkstemp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in the object database directory.

methods.name: odb_is_source_usable
methods.description: Checks if a given path is usable as an alternate object database.

methods.name: parse_alternates
methods.description: Parses a string of alternate object store paths.

methods.name: odb_source_read_alternates
methods.description: Reads alternate object store paths from a source.

methods.name: odb_source_new
methods.description: Creates a new object database source.

methods.name: odb_add_alternate_recursively
methods.description: Recursively adds alternate object stores.

methods.name: odb_source_write_alternate
methods.description: Writes an alternate object store path to the alternates file.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_file
methods.description: Adds a directory to the alternates file.

methods.name: odb_add_to_alternates_memory
methods.description: Adds an alternate object store path to memory.

methods.name: odb_set_temporary_primary_source
methods.description: Sets a temporary primary object store.

methods.name: odb_restore_primary_source
methods.description: Restores the primary object store to a previous state.

methods.name: compute_alternate_path
methods.description: Computes the path for an alternate object store.

methods.name: odb_find_source
methods.description: Finds an object store source by directory.

methods.name: odb_find_source_or_die
methods.description: Finds an object store source or terminates if not found.

methods.name: odb_add_submodule_source_by_path
methods.description: Adds a submodule source path to the object database.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate_ref
methods.description: Iterates over each alternate ref.

methods.name: odb_for_each_alternate
methods.description: Iterates over each alternate object store.

methods.name: odb_prepare_alternates
methods.description: Prepares the list of alternate object stores.

methods.name: odb_has_alternates
methods.description: Checks if there are any alternates.

methods.name: enable_obj_read_lock
methods.description: Enables locking for object reads.

methods.name: disable_obj_read_lock
methods.description: Disables locking for object reads.

methods.name: odb_reprepare
methods.description: Reprepares the object database, reloading alternates and pack files.

methods.name: odb_transaction_begin
methods.description: Begins a new object database transaction.

methods.name: odb_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits an object database transaction.
